title: Canonical Format: Multi-State Display
description: Seller-rendered premium display unit with a finite set of buyer-known visual states and breakpoint-specific canvases. The buyer supplies one `state_canvases` image for every declared state × breakpoint pair, plus a landing URL and optional shared video/copy assets. Use this canonical only when the seller renders the unit and the buyer can know every rendered layout before launch. A buyer-delivered tag is `display_tag`; per-impression algorithmic assembly is `responsive_creative`. Fullscreen and overlay states SHOULD use user-initiated triggers. The `trigger` value is the machine-readable answer to whether the unit auto-expands.

experimental.description: Experimental in AdCP 3.2 while the creative working group gathers implementation evidence across premium web-display sellers.

v1_translatable.description: No v1 named-format equivalent can express multiple seller-rendered states and their breakpoint bindings.

slots.description: Default manifest slots. `state_canvases` is array-valued; each image MUST carry `state_id` and `breakpoint_id`. Semantic validation requires exactly one image for every declared state × breakpoint pair and rejects duplicates, undeclared pairs, missing pairs, and dimension mismatches.

states.description: Finite rendering states known at buy time. State IDs and breakpoint IDs form the required canvas-key matrix.

trigger.description: Transition that enters this state. Overlay/fullscreen states SHOULD use a user-initiated value.

height_range.description: Inclusive [minimum, maximum] accepted canvas height. The first value MUST be no greater than the second; semantic validators enforce ordering.

close_affordance.description: Whether this state visibly renders a seller-controlled close affordance.

canvas_constraints.description: Rectangular areas constraining buyer artwork. Omitted state/breakpoint selectors apply the constraint to every canvas.

duration_ms_range.description: Accepted embedded-video duration [min, max]. `duration_ms_exact` takes precedence when both are present.

verifier_constraints.breakpoint_id_uniqueness: breakpoints[].breakpoint_id values must be unique within each state
verifier_constraints.height_range_order: height_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_coverage: exactly one state_canvases image per declared state and breakpoint pair
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_dimensions: canvas width must equal the declared width and height must equal fixed height or fall within height_range
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_extras: undeclared and duplicate state/breakpoint pairs are rejected
